parents.note: a layer's resolutions listed in its `parent_res` are split one file per parent cell, <layer path>/.../res=<r>/p=<parent h3>/data_0.parquet, for every (layer key, res) with more than parent_min_rows rows (others stay whole); files.parquet `parent` is that parent cell (NULL for a whole file), and its H3 resolution is the parent resolution. A viewer loads the parents covering its viewport.
